## Checklist

- [ ] An entry in `docs/CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Changes what the app shows? The user guide says so (`guide/docs/`), and the pictures are retaken (`python scripts/guide_screenshots.py`); see `guide/README.md`
- [ ] Changes a setting, a command or a way to run it? `README.md`, `docs/CONFIG.md` and `docs/run/` match
- [ ] Sets a new version? `python scripts/set_version.py <version>`
